description: "A Sermon Preach'd Before the Right Honourable the Lord-Mayor: The Aldermen and Citizens of London" by Andrew Snape is a religious sermon likely composed during the early 18th century. The text addresses the anniversary of the martyrdom of King Charles the First and seeks to explore the themes of justice, morality, and the nature of authority.
